---
title: "Lipidomics_transformation"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
lipidomics_neg_path <- 'Z:/omics/LipidomicsUntargeted_IMTM/Untargeted_Lipidomics_IMTM_LN_PutativelyAnnotatedOnly_NEG_EATRIS_20220902_DataArea.txt'
lipidomics_pos_path <- 'Z:/omics/LipidomicsUntargeted_IMTM/Untargeted_Lipidomics_IMTM_LN_PutativelyAnnotatedOnly_POS_EATRIS_20220902_DataArea.txt'

lipidomics_pos_data <- data.frame(t(read.delim(lipidomics_pos_path, row.names = 1)))
lipidomics_neg_data <- data.frame(t(read.delim(lipidomics_neg_path, row.names = 1)))

sample_names <- rownames(lipidomics_neg_data) 
```

## Log transformation

```{r Log transformation}
lipidomics_pos_data <- data.frame(lapply(lipidomics_pos_data, function(x) {log(x+1)}))
lipidomics_neg_data <- data.frame(lapply(lipidomics_neg_data, function(x) {log(x+1)}))

lipidomics_neg_data <- data.frame(t(lipidomics_neg_data))
lipidomics_pos_data <- data.frame(t(lipidomics_pos_data))

colnames(lipidomics_neg_data) <- sample_names
colnames(lipidomics_pos_data) <- sample_names
```

## Write to CSV

```{r}
write.csv(lipidomics_neg_data, 'Z:/omics/LipidomicsUntargeted_IMTM/Untargeted_Lipidomics_IMTM_LN_PutativelyAnnotatedOnly_NEG_EATRIS_20220902_DataArea_Log.csv')
write.csv(lipidomics_pos_data, 'Z:/omics/LipidomicsUntargeted_IMTM/Untargeted_Lipidomics_IMTM_LN_PutativelyAnnotatedOnly_POS_EATRIS_20220902_DataArea_Log.csv')
```
